target_description: predicted vendor performance score (≈ completion_rate, range 0.0–1.0)
reasoning_notes: Target is completion_rate (0-1) as a proxy for overall vendor performance.
High completion_rate (0.9+) vendors with strong ratings should predict ≥0.75.
Vendors with high cancellations/refunds relative to total_orders should predict ≤0.6.
avg_rating (0-5 scale) has moderate but real correlation with performance.
repeat_customer_rate near 0 despite ok completion suggests volatile service.
Models predicting outside [0.0, 1.0] are definitively wrong (clamp check).
Wide ±0.25 tolerance applied since training set may be small.

cases.description: High-performing vendor — high completion, good rating, loyal customers
Low-performing vendor — poor completion, many cancellations
Moderate vendor — decent completion but mediocre rating
New vendor — low order count, no cancellations, perfect rating
High volume vendor with moderate performance — established stall
Zero orders vendor — edge case, cold start
Very high cancellation relative to orders — distressed vendor
